title: Dense and Airy: *sűrűn*, *zsúfoltan*, *szellősen*
goal: I can say how closely buildings and people stand (*sűrűn*, *zsúfoltan*, *fojtogatóan*, *szellősen*).
I can say in short sentences who the guide in Szerb Antal's text is written for and what it shows of Buda and Pest.
I can name two ideas from the text (*genius loci*, *városi flâneur*).
